description:
Extracted adverse-event rates for a named drug or trial, by arm, with the arithmetic that was checked.

`drug` is a molecule or a brand (tirzepatide or Zepbound). `ae_type` narrows to a kind of event,
every word of it found in the stored type: discontinuation_ae is the share who stopped the drug
because of an adverse event (quit over side effects), and the others include
discontinuation_ae_gi, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, serious_ae, any_ae and death.
`available_ae_types` lists the types the named drug or trial holds. `not_published` names the
matching trials that hold no rows because their side-effect figures were never published, with
what the sponsor did say (REDEFINE 4, the CagriSema and tirzepatide head-to-head).

`verification` is carried through verbatim. It is the raw-count recomputation recorded when the
row was extracted ("997/2481 active = 40.18%"), and it is what lets a caller see that the
percentage was checked against the paper rather than copied from an abstract.
name: get_adverse_events
title: Get adverse event rates
